market.summary: Uganda has academic multi-campus catalogs, national legal-deposit/public-library coordination and municipal libraries. CUUL coordinates research-information access; its VuFind site is a promising but unverified union-holdings route. Library subscriptions and repositories are separate from physical availability.
market.platform_strategy: Prioritize bounded Koha adapter reuse for Gulu, MUBS and KIU, plus a custom permitted frontend for Bugema. Reuse is a candidate only: no app integration or market-share claim. Preserve reference/reserve/Not For Loan/in-transit statuses. Investigate CUUL/RENU agreements and indexed institutional provenance before treating its discovery interface as a network unlock.

limitations: Ten substantial selected libraries were not verified: four selected and two reserves; six selected-target shortfall.
No national largest-ten ranking established; dates and units differ, and two selected institutions use explicit facility/institutional proxies.
No national LMS market-share denominator; sample is shaped by discoverability, robots policy and server reachability.
Public OPAC results do not grant visitor entry, borrowing rights, metadata reuse or live circulation guarantees.
No credentials, sessions, holds, outreach, application changes, authentication or challenge bypass; no robots-excluded search routes requested.
Search failure or zero results does not mean a library lacks a title.
CUUL member cards and catalog branch selectors are not independent verified institutions.
Source-index snippets are labelled where direct raw source was not obtained; recrawl dates are not collection census dates.
